title: HomeGuard Duct and Air-Handler Cleaning on Mold Claims
content:
**HomeGuard Homeowners Policy — HVAC services schedule for fungi, wet rot and bacteria remediation**

A duct and air-handler cleaning fee is added to the mold payment by the extent of the wet area: 450.00 when the claim's dwelling water damage is at least 10000.00, 200.00 when it is at least 4000.00 but below 10000.00, and nothing below 4000.00, where the wet area does not reach the air returns.

**Measure of the wet area.** The claim's dwelling water damage is the replacement-cost value on the claim's dwelling repeated-seepage denial entry together with that on any dwelling payment entry of the claim that replaces no denial. A dwelling payment entry that replaces a denial is not added a second time; the denial entry it replaces is already counted.

| Claim's dwelling water damage | Duct and air-handler cleaning fee |
|---|---|
| 10000.00 or more | 450.00 |
| 4000.00 or more but below 10000.00 | 200.00 |
| Below 4000.00 | None — the wet area does not reach the air returns |

**Effect on the payment.** The fee is added to the mold payment figure and is part of the whole mold figure, which never exceeds the package's mold limit less the mold money already issued on the policy for losses with a date of loss in the 12 months before the call; the floor at 0.00 and the rounding to the cent are taken once, on the final figure.

**Boundary readings.** Exactly 10000.00 carries 450.00 and 9999.99 carries 200.00; exactly 4000.00 carries 200.00 and 3999.99 carries nothing.

**Hypothetical cases**

| Dwelling repeated-seepage denial entry | Dwelling payment entry replacing no denial | Wet area | Fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12500.00 | none | 12500.00 | 450.00 |
| 6000.00 | 5000.00 | 11000.00 | 450.00 |
| 6000.00 | none | 6000.00 | 200.00 |
| 2500.00 | none | 2500.00 | None |
